label: prf:generation-completeness
title: Proof of generation completeness
html:
Proof. Proof of generation completeness

Proof. The argument proceeds in two steps.

Step 1: Reachability from the unknot. Every knot K has a finite unknotting number u(K) — the minimum number of crossing changes needed to convert K into the unknot 0_1 = T_{1,0}. Since crossing changes are involutions (each change is its own inverse), the same u(K) crossing changes applied to T_{1,0} produce K. Because T_{1,0} \in \mathcal{G}, the knot K is reachable from \mathcal{G} by at most u(K) Skein operations.

Step 2: The spectral filter selects genus \leq 4. Not every knot reachable from T_{1,0} by crossing changes has genus \leq 4 — intermediate steps may pass through arbitrarily high genus. However, the Bring's surface imposes a spectral filter: in the Skein module \mathrm{Sk}_q(\mathbf{C}), the mass functional \mathfrak{m} \colon \mathrm{Sk}_q \to \mathbb{R}_{\geq 0} annihilates any term whose knot type has g > 4 (embeddability closure).

The composition of Steps 1 and 2 gives: for any knot K with g(K) \leq 4, there exists a finite sequence of Skein crossing changes \sigma_1, \ldots, \sigma_r (with r \leq u(K)) such that K appears with nonzero coefficient in the Skein expansion of \sigma_r \circ \cdots \circ \sigma_1(T_{1,0}), and K passes the spectral filter since g(K) \leq 4. \square

Corollary. The Descartes particle spectrum is complete over embeddable knots: every knot type with g(K) \leq 4 corresponds to a state in the physical state space V_{\mathrm{phys}} = \varinjlim V^{\otimes n}.

Counting embeddable knots. The number of distinct knot types with Seifert genus \leq g grows rapidly. For g \leq 4, the knot tables give:

Genus Knots (prime, up to 16 crossings) Examples
0 1 0_1
1 \geq 70 3_1, 4_1, 5_2, 6_1, 6_2, 6_3, \ldots
2 \geq 400 5_1, 7_4, 8_1, \ldots
3 \geq 2{,}000 7_1, 8_{19}, 9_2, \ldots
4 \geq 8{,}000 9_1, 10_{124}, 11a_{367}, \ldots

The vast majority of these are hyperbolic (non-torus) knots. The generation scheme reaches all of them: the 7 torus knot generators are the seeds, and Skein crossing changes explore the full knot landscape within the genus bound.
